title: Recover a queue ejection before release enrollment
trigger: A queued PR is unmergeable in its train while it remains mergeable against the base, or an item has an open correction landing.
need: Read the snapshotted preceding PRs and shared files. Wait until those entries land or leave, then re-read base mergeability: rebase and re-verify a conflicting head; re-enqueue an unchanged mergeable head through the observer. The server record drives merge --wait and names read failures with recovery. Release admission and containment refuse a current run member's open correction PR until it lands or closes; a member removed from the run never blocks it. For an unexplained failed train, message steering with the test and CI run URL, then claim one retry with merge item --retry-flake. A missing web URL is derived from the identified Actions run id and repository. The item stores the head/base reservation before arming and refuses a second claim; rejected entry releases that attempt's reservation, while accepted or uncertain entry keeps it spent. The second failure belongs to the item. Automatic conflict re-entry requests Contents: write as well as Pull requests: write.
